text:
Dylan H: Head's up — clearing out office stuff before moving. Free pickup SF: one ASUS 32" 4K monitor (PD/60Hz, HDMI+DP, VESA), a lightly used mesh task chair (no armrests), and 2x day-pass tickets to the SF Tech Talks conference (single-day, May 22). Happy to ship monitor at buyer cost but prefer pickup. First-come, first-served.

Carmen L: Interested in the chair if it's still available. Any rips? How's the lumbar?

Dylan H: @Carmen L chair is clean, no rips, lumbar is adjustable but the knob is a little stiff. Pics: https://files.redwood.ai/attach/mesh-chair-181535.jpg

Nate: I'll take the monitor if no one local wants it. Can pick up Saturday morning.

Dylan H: @Nate monitor's available. It's been used as a dev screen, color profile is default. I'll leave the OSD calibration exported on a USB stick with it. Please bring 2 people for moving; it's heavy-ish.

Carmen L: I'll take the chair. Can meet Friday 9am at storage B to pick up?

Alex - Facilities: FYI we can help at 9am with a dolly. If @Dylan leaves the items in storage B I'll set a temporary access code for that window.

Nate: Quick Q — does the monitor have HDR? And is the stand height-adjustable?

Dylan H: @Nate it's not HDR, but has decent color. Stand is height + tilt. No swivel. I'll leave calibrated profile on the USB.

Carmen L: Thanks!! @Alex - Facilities can you reserve the dolly for 9am?

Alex - Facilities: Yup reserved. I'll be there at 8:55 to help. Please label the box with names. :truck: 

Nate: If the monitor is large for my car, I can Venmo $15 for @Alex to bring it downstairs and meet me at the loading dock. Sound fair?

Dylan H: @Nate that's fine. Venmo handle in DM. If anyone wants the two SF Tech Talks passes, they're transferable via email. No fee.

Carmen L: @Dylan taking the chair confirmed. Leaving a note in storage B under "Carmen" works for me.

transfers-bot: Transfer link sent to Dylan H and pending acceptance for SF Tech Talks ticket 1 and ticket 2.

Nate: I'll Venmo @Dylan for the dock help and swing by at 9:30 if that's okay.

Dylan H: Great. Summary: monitor -> @Nate (pickup Saturday, Venmo for dock help), chair -> @Carmen (pickup Fri 9am, @Alex assisting), tickets -> available (sent transfer link). I'll update if anything changes. Cheers! :handshake:
